purpose: Store scanner recommendations/outcomes so future ranking can learn execution quality without overfitting to one trade.

completed.lesson: A low-unit-price spread with fresh prints and enough turnover can execute cleanly. Give credit to executable spread + volume + manageable limit, but never automatically repeat the item.

recommended_but_outcome_unconfirmed.rule: Do not count as win/loss without user-confirmed fill and exit.

negative_pattern_examples: Large theoretical ROI caused by stale/asynchronous or ultra-thin prints
5-minute price already sharply above 1-hour level = chase risk
Wide spread while aggressive flow is overwhelmingly seller-side = possible falling knife
Tiny unit volume despite large GP spread = exit/trap risk
One successful historical flip is not evidence the same item is still mispriced
feedback_rule: Only confirmed executions may change empirical scanner confidence. Keep market-condition features separate from item identity to reduce overfitting.
